- Per-tenant queues with in-order delivery
- Bounded buffers and backpressure strategies

```go
  GlobalBuf chan Event
}
```

- How would you detect and mitigate tenant-level starvation under skewed traffic?
- How would you handle dynamic tenant churn (adding/removing tenants) without pausing processing?
